methods.label: Use opposite square roots
methods.explanation: The two square roots of a positive number are opposites, so \((2a-1)+(-a+4)=0\), giving \(a=-3\). The two square roots are \(-7\) and \(7\), so the positive number is \(49\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the Grade 7 opposite-root property, a linear equation, substitution, and squaring.
